review_fixes: Unit changes no longer relabel old numeric observations.
Finite input values cannot overflow the descriptive mean.
Record corrections cannot silently deduplicate away the corrected record.
Task retention is enforced through direct API operations as well as the CLI.
Task context returns detached data and only selected authorized evidence.
ASCII-safe JSON output preserves Persian while preventing post-commit failures under legacy console encodings.
publication_checks: Run scripts/validate_package.py against the final manifest. Hosted CI separately exercises Ubuntu Python 3.11/3.12/3.13 and Windows Python 3.12; local results do not assert those hosted outcomes.
not_tested: Real Dot or Grok account execution
Real native agent provisioning or cross-provider data isolation
Real wearable/calendar connectors, reminders or external writes
Participant usefulness, clinical efficacy, production readiness
data_boundary: All runtime and protocol test inputs are synthetic. No private source transcript or participant state is distributed.
